not_covered.text: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi states that Egypt will take all necessary steps to protect and defend Saudi Arabia should the Kingdom so desire.
Ten tourists are killed and nine others sustain injuries after a resort catches fire in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh
A Piper Tomahawk II aircraft crashes near Drymen, Stirling, Scotland, killing the two people on board.
Protesters force their way into Marseille's town hall and vandalize the interior before being dispersed.
In Lille, protesters storm the city hall and damage the premises prior to being removed by security forces.
Dozens of shops are looted across major French cities amid widespread rioting and civil unrest.
The Hôtel de Ville in Limoges is destroyed by fire.
The fourth round of No Kings protests are held against U.S. president Donald Trump and his administration and to encourage early voting ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
